name: @acyclic/harness
description: Generic durable substrate and fully composable agent runtime

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml -p acyclic-harness --no-default-features --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm-release --locked && wasm-bindgen ../../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm-release/acyclic_harness.wasm --target web --out-dir generated/wasm --out-name acyclic_harness_wasm
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test test
